info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Campaign Reviews Submission API
info.description: The Customer Campaign Reviews Submission API enables businesses to efficiently collect feedback on their customer campaign executions. By allowing users to submit reviews based on their experiences, this API serves as a vital tool for enhancing customer satisfaction and improving campaign strategies. Common use cases involve marketing teams and customer service representatives who leverage this feedback to refine their initiatives. With the ability to post reviews through this endpoint, organizations can gain valuable insights and ensure ongoing engagement with their customers.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a review for a specific customer campaign identified by CUST-100045. Upon successful execution, a new review entry will be added, helping to enhance the feedback mechanisms for customer engagements.

requestBody.description: The request body must contain the information related to the reviews being submitted for the customer campaign execution identified by CUST-100045. Ensure that all required fields are included as specified in the schema.
